final: WITH baseline AS (SELECT AVG(bandusagepct) as baseline_avg FROM telescopes WHERE bandusagepct IS NOT NULL), station_avgs AS (SELECT observstation, AVG(bandusagepct) as station_avg FROM telescopes WHERE bandusagepct IS NOT NULL GROUP BY observstation), above_baseline AS (SELECT station_avgs.station_avg, (station_avgs.station_avg - baseline.baseline_avg) as excess FROM station_avgs, baseline WHERE station_avgs.station_avg > baseline.baseline_avg) SELECT AVG(station_avg) as mean_of_above_baseline_stations, AVG(excess) as mean_excess FROM above_baseline
